ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens, mostly fresh spinach-like leaves with dark green glossy surfaces and some lighter veins, dressed with a light sheen; scattered dried red berries or cranberries (dark red, wrinkled, about 0.5-1 cm), thin orange carrot shreds, and small pale slivered almonds or nuts; occupies about 30% of the plate in an irregular mound roughly 9 cm across and 3 cm tall, sitting on the left side of the plate | 90

ITEM 2 | Roasted cubed yellow-orange root vegetable, pieces about 2-3 cm with golden-brown caramelized edges and soft pale yellow interiors, mixed with darker charred green-brown pieces (possibly pepper or similar), glossy with light oil; piled in a cluster about 9 cm by 6 cm and 2-2.5 cm tall on the upper right of the plate | 110

ITEM 3 | Two slices of flatbread-style crust with charred, blistered brown edges and pale golden interior, topped with thick red tomato slices (about 4-5 cm wide, juicy, slightly glossy, with seeds visible) and a few small green herb leaves; sits at the bottom of the plate, roughly 12 cm by 6 cm total footprint and about 1.5 cm thick | 95

ITEM 4 | Light olive-green oily dressing or oil sheen visible on the salad leaves and vegetables, thin film, no distinct pool | 5
